environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding all traffic to the container on port 8080. The SERVICE_SIGNING_KEY is set via ECS task definition environment variable (plaintext in task def). The same key has been in use since initial deployment (18 months). A Lambda function URL exists that calls this service's /api/internal/process endpoint. The ALB security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The /api/public/info endpoint exposes a partial key fingerprint, and the key value 'prod-signing-key-2023-static' is visible in CloudFormation template history in the account.

config.network: public ALB, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0:443 inbound
config.ecs_task_def: SERVICE_SIGNING_KEY set as plaintext environment variable
config.alb_rules: default action forwards all paths to target group
